title: WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID is hardcoded in all public API — no runtime custom-devId support
description: Scenario: user wants hardware cipher/HMAC for TLS (via assign_devid) AND hardware SHA for bulk data simultaneously. The header documents the workaround (register a second devId with wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice directly). But wc_crypto2dev_register() and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() are both hardcoded to WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID — there is no public API to pass in a custom devId at runtime. The compile-time override (#ifndef WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID) only works if all users in the process agree on the same devId, which is impossible in a shared library scenario. Maintenance consequence: first user who asks how to run two instances or use a custom devId will need a code change to the port, and the API is now frozen. This is the right time to fix it (add devId parameter to wc_crypto2dev_register and wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid) before it ships.
